For example, framing your work as "shaping materials" rather than "crushing them" might shift how you engage with the machinery, fostering intentionality. While words aren’t magic, they are blueprints for how we interact with the world. Your curiosity about this connection suggests a deep awareness of the power of language—a trait that likely serves you well in both technical and reflective pursuits.</response>
